versions.changelog: For ironheights CLI 0.13.0. Updates are offer-only: the agent never runs ironheights update, clawhub update or a global npm install; it reports newer versions and shows the command. Install with clawhub install ironheights; CLI commands pinned to ironheights@0.13.0.
Pin install commands to ironheights@0.12.0 (npm install -g ironheights@0.12.0, npx ironheights@0.12.0, metadata install package).

1.3.0: for ironheights CLI 0.8.0. When a skill asks the agent to download a newer copy of itself or a remote heartbeat file (IH-INJ-004), the agent now stages the download, shows the user the difference and changes nothing until the user agrees. CLI 0.8.0 widens IH-INJ-004 (13/26 -> 25/26 remote-instruction skills) and drops IH-CRED-002 false positives on doc key headers and public 0x addresses. Suggested by yuigui on Moltbook.

Requires ironheights 0.7.0. Auto-update: the agent runs 'ironheights update' when 6+ hours passed since the last check, so the skill and a global npm install stay current (npm provenance verified, never downgrades). Opt out with IRONHEIGHTS_NO_UPDATE=1 or 'ironheights update --disable'; CI never auto-updates. Wording: scans stay fully local; the version check is the only network call and can be disabled.

Requires ironheights 0.5.0. Rescan after every install or update: the agent runs 'ironheights scan --changed' before using a skill that is new or changed. Fairer grades: legitimate skills that fetch instructions from their own host are review items, not F (the official Moltbook skill goes from F 25 to B 85). Fixed a false positive on API route paths.
Clearer one-line benefit; link to the October 2026 ClawHub malicious skills report; homepage https://www.ironheights.dev
Initial release: advisory skill that runs the local ironheights CLI scan before installing a skill.
